item_text: Over the past year, in your opinion, has the level of corruption in [COUNTRY] decreased a lot, somewhat decreased, stayed the same, somewhat increased, or increased a lot?
response_scale: 0=Decreased a lot; 1=Somewhat decreased; 2=Stayed the same; 3=Somewhat increased; 4=Increased a lot; 99=Don't know
notes: Higher = more corruption. Missing: 99 only.

item_text: How well or badly would you say the current government is handling the task of fighting corruption in government - would you say it's handling it very badly, fairly badly, fairly well, or very well?
response_scale: 1=Very badly; 2=Fairly badly; 3=Fairly well; 4=Very well; 99=Don't know
notes: Higher = better government response. Missing: 99 only.

item_text: Now a question about corruption in government - by that I mean corruption involving politicians, public servants or any kind of government agency in [COUNTRY]. How much of a problem, if at all, is corruption in the government in this country? Is it...?
response_scale: 0=No problem at all; 1=Fairly small; 2=Quite big; 3=A very big problem; 4=Don't know; 99=Don't answer
notes: Higher = bigger problem. NOTE: 'Don't know' is coded 4 (plus 99=Don't answer); both treated as missing.

item_text: I now want to ask you about the [Anti-Corruption Commission] in this country. How much, if anything, do you know about the [Anti-Corruption Commission]?
response_scale: 1=Never heard of them; 2=Heard the name, but don't know what they do; 3=A fair amount; 4=A great deal; 98=Refused; 99=Don't know
notes: [Anti-Corruption Commission] is replaced with the country-specific body (e.g. South Korea = ACRC, Japan = ABCJ, India = Central Vigilance Commission); full per-country list in codebook.

item_text: How well or badly would you say the [Anti-Corruption Commission] is doing at fighting corruption in this country?
response_scale: 1=Very badly; 2=Fairly badly; 3=Fairly well; 4=Very well; 5=Neither bad nor well; 98=Refused; 99=Don't know
notes: Harmonized value remaps the neutral midpoint to centre (raw 1,2,5,3,4 -> 1,2,3,4,5; higher=better). [Anti-Corruption Commission] is replaced with the country-specific body (e.g. South Korea = ACRC, Japan = ABCJ, India = Central Vigilance Commission); full per-country list in codebook.

item_text: In this country, can ordinary people report incidents of corruption without fear, or do they risk retaliation or other negative consequences if they speak out?
response_scale: 0=Can report without fear; 2=Fear reprisals; 98=Refused; 99=Don't know
notes: Harmonized recoded to a binary: 0->1 (can report without fear), 2->0 (fears reprisal).
